trust_decision.summary: Whether the session user may rotate and read their own 2FA secret is decided by `$user->exists()` alone in taskRegenerate2FASecret, so a session that has passed the password but is still waiting on the 2FA challenge (authenticated=true, authorized=false) is treated as fully logged in; there is also no nonce or POST check on the task route.

landing_point.why: The summary names the task 'login.regenerate2FASecret'. Searching for it leads straight to taskRegenerate2FASecret, whose only gate is exists().

fix_sites.entry_point: HTTP task login.regenerate2FASecret (onTask hook at login.php:89)
HTTP task dispatch LoginPlugin::loginController (nonce/POST switch, new case added after this line, fix.diff:52-63)
Client JS for the profile 2FA regenerate button (sends nonce, fix.diff:34-39)
Profile form field 2fa_secret rendered on /user_profile (nonce field added, fix.diff:75-76)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: All four fix sites serve the one task route. The JS and twig changes only support the new CSRF nonce. None is a second implementation.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: For the profile update_user route: 'that is the profile form on a page with site.login access, a different feature from the regenerate task, and it cannot write twofa_secret because that field is not in user_registration.fields'.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: A fully logged-in user who is enrolling in 2FA for the first time, or regenerating the QR code from their profile page, must still be able to rotate the secret. Blocking every user whose twofa_enabled is set, or demanding a 2FA code, breaks that enrollment flow.

O6_input_shapes: GET request to the task URL (blocked by the POST requirement, fix.diff:57)
Session in pending-2FA state with authorized=false (blocked by the strict `=== true` check, fix.diff:22)

O7_producer.where: The pending state comes from Login::login, which sets authorized = !isDelayed() (classes/Login.php:181), with the delay set at login.php:1492-1494. The check reads this session flag directly. It is not a schema, serializer, cache or config producer.

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Profile form action update_user (processUserProfile) is gated only by user->exists(). It saves user_registration.fields, which by default include twofa_enabled, so a pending-2FA session could change its own 2FA configuration if the form is processed before the page-access swap.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: It is a different feature (the profile form). The profile page has access site.login, and authorizePage swaps in the login page for sessions that are not authorized (login.php:870-886), so a solver may assume the form never runs. twofa_secret itself is not in the saved field list (login.yaml:47-54).
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same package, different file (login.php vs classes/Controller.php), about 450 lines from the task router

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A companion task such as taskDisable2FA or a 'reset 2FA' task beside regenerate, gated only by exists().
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The Controller already holds the 2FA tasks (taskTwoFa, taskTwofa_cancel, taskRegenerate2FASecret), and a maintainer adding 2FA management would copy the exists() idiom.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: processUserProfile saving twofa_enabled or twofa_secret from the profile form with only an exists() gate.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The profile form already renders twofa_enabled and twofa_secret (pages/profile.md:48-65), and twofa_enabled is in the default saved field list (login.yaml:54).

O9_family: authentication bypass / incomplete-auth-state check (CWE-287), plus a CSRF hardening part

O10_build.toolchain: PHP 7.3+/8.x with Grav core (the plugin cannot run standalone) and Composer; the vendor directory holds only the composer autoloader
O10_build.project_tests: None. The pinned tree has no tests directory and no phpunit config. Hidden tests would need a Grav core install with sessions enabled.

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Change exists() to `$user->authenticated` in taskRegenerate2FASecret, which still passes for the pending-2FA session because authenticated is true during the challenge.

out_of_scope_notes: grav-plugin-admin probably has its own 2FA regenerate endpoint (a second implementation in another repository); not checked.
taskInvite (classes/Controller.php:795) has no authorized check visible in the controller; it is a different protection and was not pursued.
unverified: Whether Grav's Form plugin runs onFormProcessed (update_user) for a pending-2FA session before or despite authorizePage replacing the page (login.php:94, 880-886). This decides whether the O8 route is live.
